# AniHubStream — Full Platform Specification & Knowledge Graph

> Comprehensive system documentation, entity taxonomy, streaming architecture, and metadata schemas for LLMs and AI search engines.

## 1. Platform Identity
- **Name:** AniHubStream
- **Website:** https://anihubstream.com
- **Type:** Video Streaming Aggregator & Anime Encyclopedia
- **Target Audience:** Anime fans worldwide seeking high-definition streaming, accurate broadcast airtimes, and synchronized subtitle tracks.
- **Access Model:** Free access, zero paywalls, instant browser playback across desktop and mobile.

## 2. Content Taxonomy & Catalogue
AniHubStream indexes television series, theatrical films, OVAs, ONAs, and special releases:
- **Formats:** TV, Movie, OVA, ONA, Special.
- **Genres:** Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life, Sports, Supernatural, Thriller.
- **Languages:** Japanese (original audio), English (dub), Hindi (regional multi-audio), Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese.
- **Subtitles:** Multi-language WebVTT renditions including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, and Russian.
- **Metadata Sources:** Canonical IDs aligned across AniList, MyAnimeList (MAL), Kitsu, and Fribb ID mappings.

## 3. Streaming & Player Architecture
- **Protocol:** HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) with adaptive bitrate ladder (360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p).
- **Multi-Server Redundancy:** Edge streaming bridges resolve active streams across AniKoto, HiAnime, AniWatch, and AniPM.
- **Opening/Ending Automation:** Automated intro/outro skipping powered by AniSkip timestamps (Opening `op`, Ending `ed`, Recap `recap`).
- **Edge Deployment:** Hosted globally on Cloudflare Pages and D1 SQLite edge database, delivering sub-100ms API response times.

## 4. Crawling & Discoverability Guidelines for AI Agents
- **Canonical URLs:**
  - Overview / Series Detail: `https://anihubstream.com/anime/{slug}`
  - Episode Stream: `https://anihubstream.com/watch/{slug}/{episode}`
  - Airing Schedule: `https://anihubstream.com/schedule`
  - Catalog Browser: `https://anihubstream.com/anime`
- **Machine Readability:** All anime detail and watch pages deliver semantic pre-rendered HTML crawler shells for automated scrapers, accompanied by JSON-LD `TVSeries`, `TVEpisode`, and `BreadcrumbList` schema.
- **Search API:** `https://anihubstream.com/api/search?q={query}` returns normalized anime search results in JSON.

## 5. Contact & Rights
- **DMCA Notices:** https://anihubstream.com/dmca
- **Support:** https://anihubstream.com/contact
